description: Create a metric based on RUM data (count or distribution, with filters and group-by)

aggregationType.description: Aggregation type. 'count' counts events, 'distribution' creates a distribution metric

eventType.description: The RUM event type to use. Example: view

filterQuery.description: RUM search query to filter events. Example: @service:my-app @view.url_path:/checkout

groupBy.description: Fields to group the metric by

path.description: Path to the value to aggregate over. Example: @view.url_path

tagName.description: Tag name for the group. Defaults to path if not specified

id.description: The name of the rum-based metric. Example: rum.page_view_count

includePercentiles.description: Whether to include percentile aggregations. Only for distribution metrics

path.description: Path to the metric value. Required for distribution metrics. Example: @view.loading_time

uniquenessWhen.description: When to count uniqueness. Only for session/view event types. 'match' = when event matches, 'end' = when session/view ends

name: create-rum-metric
